import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int B = 1000000;
    static final int M = 998244353;
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static long n, cnt1, cnt2;
    static int[] sum = new int[10];
    static int ans;
    static List<Integer>[] val = new ArrayList[10];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            val[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(val[i]);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(i);
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static void dfs1(int d, long v) {
        if (d > 6) return;
        int w = (int)((++cnt1 - v + M) % M);
        val[d].add(w);
        sum[d] = (sum[d] + w) % mod;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs1(d + 1, v * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(long v) {
        if (v > n) return;
        if (v < n / B && 10 * v > n / B) {
            for (int i = 0, pw = 1; i <= 6; i++, pw *= 10) {
                int w = (int)((cnt2 + (long)(M - pw) * v + M) % M);
                List<Integer> listVal = val[i];
                int c = listVal.size() - lowerBound(listVal, M - w);
                ans = (int)((ans + (long)listVal.size() * w + sum[i] + (long)(mod - M) * c) % mod);
            }
            cnt2 += cnt1;
            return;
        }
        cnt2++;
        ans = (int)((ans + (cnt2 - v % M + M) % M) % mod);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(v * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }
}
